DL1 Flush (Applies for SKUs where there is no LLC.):
An explicit DL1 flush is NOT needed if data is pulled through code fetches.
DL1 flush is needed, if the BIOS decides to copy data into CAR region.
DL1 flush can be achieved by programming MSR 0x10B[0]
BIT0 = 0 //DL1 is not flushed.
BIT0 = 1 //DL1 is flushed.
Hub-Die E-cores can be disabled via BIOS based on the same core disable straps that exist today.
